starter_agents.job: Account research before a first call
starter_agents.try_first: Give it the company and the attendees' roles; get a one-page call plan with 10 ranked discovery questions.
Paste this week's notes and Slack threads; review the draft before it goes anywhere.

starter_agents.source: Grok Bot Outbound Prospecting template (Krista Letz)
starter_agents.try_first: Give it 5 target companies; it returns a sourced review list and sends nothing.
Paste the questionnaire plus your approved security docs; it answers only from them and marks gaps NEEDS REVIEW.
Start with 20-50 real example inputs; it walks you through the build, the evals and a pass-rate report.

starter_agents.source: guide: prospecting-agent-setup.html (built on Grok Bot's official Sales Outbound use case)
starter_agents.try_first: Run the prompt by hand once, then schedule it to stop at the review list.

method: Start here and Advanced are our picks (labeled "Our pick" with a reason). Tools with public GitHub repos show GitHub stars and last commit from the public GitHub API with the date checked, refreshed daily; alternatives are sorted by stars. Public signals only, nothing paid, any featured spot labeled.

releases.name: Cline Cloud sessions (Cline v4.1.25)
releases.summary: Runs a Cline coding task in a hosted sandbox on a GitHub repo and branch you choose, keeps it running after you close your editor and notifies you when it finishes. It is rolling out gradually and is turned on in Settings.

releases.name: Claude Code Code Review (GA)
releases.summary: Multi-agent reviewer that automatically checks every new GitHub pull request, verifies its findings and posts them as inline comments ranked by severity, with Quick, Standard or Deep levels set per repo.

releases.name: Claude Code desktop: parallel and nested sessions
releases.summary: The Claude Code desktop app now starts sessions faster, saves reusable environments (folders, SSH or cloud, optional Git worktrees), and runs parallel tasks as nested sessions that report back to the main thread, with a sidebar showing which sessions are working or waiting.

releases.name: Claude Platform OpenTelemetry tracing (public beta)
releases.summary: Sends OpenTelemetry traces for every agent turn, model call and tool use from Claude Managed Agents, the Messages API and the Claude SDKs to any OTLP tool, such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust, Datadog, Arize or New Relic.

releases.name: ZoomInfo native n8n node (via GTM.AI)
releases.summary: A verified n8n node, maintained by ZoomInfo, that searches contacts and companies, enriches records and monitors buyer intent at run time, and that n8n AI agents can also call as a tool.
